'''2008 Texas Match Play Championship Day 2 Scott Lingrell DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2008 Texas Match Play Championship]] (Day 2). The printout's Player Name box is blank; the file name printed in its footer is <code>scottds_day2.html</code>.

The sheet lists 60 cards and, under the heading Defensive Shields, twelve more; they are given here as printed.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS15]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
